vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #1705 — triage summary excludes closed cached issues

plan.title: Triage summary counts exclude closed upstream issues

narratives.Description: computeSummary in packages/core/src/triage/summary/index.ts classifies every cached github-issue by audit decision alone. Closed issues with accept still inflate in_flight_cache_scoped; closed issues with no decision still count as untriaged.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. When iterating cached issues in computeSummary, read raw.json state (or equivalent cache payload) and skip closed issues from untriaged / in_flight_cache_scoped / stale_defer counts.
2. Optionally expose closed-issue skip in iterCachedIssues or a filter helper; keep reconcilable logic consistent.
3. Add regression tests in packages/core/src/triage/summary/index.test.ts with closed+accepted and closed+untriaged fixtures.
4. CHANGELOG entry. Closes #1705.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator reading the session-start triage one-liner, I want counts to reflect only open upstream issues, so that accepted-then-closed issues do not inflate in-flight numbers.
narratives.Overview: Cache-scoped summary ignores GitHub state field.

items.title: Closed issues excluded from summary counts

narrative.Acceptance: Given a cached issue with state=closed and latest decision accept, when computeSummary runs, then in_flight_cache_scoped does not include it.

items.title: Regression tests for closed cache entries

narrative.Acceptance: Given index.test.ts fixtures for closed accepted and closed untriaged entries, when vitest runs, then counts match open-issue-only semantics.
